subject: Sponsor intro + CIO compact briefing — proposed windows and delegate plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Patel <kiran.patel@stratusware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor intro + CIO compact briefing — proposed windows and delegate plan

Hi Kiran / Elena,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. Kiran — per your note about lining up a short executive briefing for your CIO, we think a compact 30-minute slot focused on the production-readiness and cost guardrails will be the highest signal. That will let us: 

- Surface expected latency/cost for a 100k-user workflow
- Walk through Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs for data residency
- Highlight the rollout & rollback safety nets we recommend for CIOs

Proposed windows (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-05-26 09:00–09:30
- Tue 2026-05-26 11:30–12:00
- Wed 2026-05-27 15:00–15:30

If your CIO needs a longer slot we can extend to 45 minutes but suggest keeping the first 20 minutes reserved for high-level executive concerns.

Attendees from our side: Marissa (VP Product) and Ben (Solutions Engineer). If the CIO prefers a deputy, Marissa can handle the product-level questions and Ben will cover runtime/ops. Priyom is on standby for procurement questions — I’ve attached a draft agenda and the SOW we intend to discuss.

Attachments:
- demo-agenda-30m-v1.xlsx (outline + timebox)
- SOW-draft-v1.pdf (high-level commercial terms)

Quick asks: can you confirm the CIO’s availability for any of the above windows? If none work, propose two alternatives and whether procurement should join.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Kiran Patel <kiran.patel@stratusware.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stratusware.com>, procurement <procurement@stratusware.com>

Subject: Re: Sponsor intro + CIO compact briefing — proposed windows and delegate plan

Mina — thanks for the clear options and materials.

The CIO (Ravi) is traveling on 5/26 and the only brief window he's available next week is 5/27 between 14:30–15:15 PT. That would be a 45-minute block for us. Procurement asked to be looped; I cc'd them. A couple of quick preferences from our side:

- Extend to 45 minutes (15 minutes for technical Q&A)
- We prefer the SOW not be discussed line-by-line in the first briefing; high-level commercial outline only
- If Ravi cannot attend last-minute, Elena (Head of Infra) will sit in and take notes — she can make decisions up to pilot approval.

Can you confirm you can stretch to 45m on 5/27 14:30–15:15 PT? Also please remove line-item pricing from the SOW we share externally (procurement will want a sanitized copy).

—Kiran
Kiran Patel
Director, IT Strategy — StratusWare

Thanks Kiran — 5/27 14:30–15:15 PT works for us. Mina: quick note on coverage if Ravi has a hard conflict:

- If CIO attends: we’ll keep to the 45m cadence you suggested (20m exec walkthrough, 20m tech Q&A, 5m next steps)
- If CIO is a no-show and Elena joins: Marissa will lead the exec portion and Ben will deep-dive on ops.
- If Elena also needs to pull out, Priyom can step in for procurement commercial clarifications.

Ben — please bundle a one-slide latency/cost snapshot we can use at the start (tokenized per-10k-users baseline). Ben, can you add that slide to the agenda and produce a sanitized SOW that redacts line-item pricing? I think procurement only needs the milestones and term sheet at this stage.

Marissa Cole

Mina / team — all good, confirmed for Wed 2026-05-27 14:30–15:15 PT. A couple of logistics: 

1) Please send a cleansed SOW (redacted pricing) to procurement ahead of the meeting. procurement@stratusware.com will circulate internally.
2) Send the agenda with Ben’s latency/cost slide attached; we’ll want to surface that in the first 10 minutes.
3) We require a short one-paragraph data residency statement for the CIO briefing — can you include a 2–3 line note about where customer data resides and which KMS options are supported?

Also: we have an internal policy that any external SOW is routed through legal if pilot terms exceed $50k — procurement will flag if needed. No action unless they ask.

Looking forward — Elena
